# Salesmate

Salesmate is an AI-powered CRM platform designed to help businesses engage leads, close deals faster, nurture relationships, and provide seamless support through a unified, intuitive interface.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/salesmate/.

## Actions

- **Add Product**: Add a new product.
- **Create Company**: Create a new company in the salesmate crm.
- **Delete Product**: Delete a product by productid.
- **Get Active Users**: Retrieve all active users.
- **Get Company**: Retrieve details of a specific company by id.
- **List Modules**: List all modules.
